title: Junior Dan - House is not a Home

lines.l: A chair is still a chair

You hold you close
And no one there
You can kiss goodnight

Even when there's no room living there
But a room is still a room
And a house is not a home

And one of us has a broken heart
Now and then
I call your name
And suddenly
You face a fear
But it's just
Game to play
And when it ends

But darling, have a heart
